verdict.rationale: Publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for an IaC tool with a registry and ecosystem, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such spec: every OpenAPI and Swagger path probed returned 404. The JSON test-log output and the nightly latest.json build feed are adjacent machine-readable artifacts, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
